CRL.M.C. 3472/2023 & CRL.M.A. 13055/2023 This is a petition seeking quashing of the FIR No.
643/2017 dated 08.09.2017 registered under Section 406/498A IPC registered at PS Uttam Nagar.
The parties have arrived at a settlement through which the parties have settled their disputes and the statement to that effect has been recorded by the learned Judge, Family Court-01 on 20.03.2023.
The petitioner and the respondent No.2 are both present in Court and have been identified by SI Tej Ram, PS Uttam Nagar.
The parties state that they have arrived at a settlement out of their own This is a digitally signed order.

sentences.text: The respondent No.2 states that she has no objection if the present FIR is quashed.
There are 2 children born out of the wedlock.

It is directed that the settlement as well as this order shall not come in the way of both the children claiming their rights of inheritance, maintenance,
education, marriage etc. against either of the parties.
For the said reasons, the FIR No. 643/2017 dated 08.09.2017 registered under Section 406/498A IPC registered at PS Uttam Nagar is hereby quashed.
The petition is disposed of in the aforesaid terms.
JASMEET SINGH, J MAY 16, 2023 / (MS)
